description: Create DTOs, service layer, and business logic for fund transfers with validation, error handling, and transaction processing
steps: Create TransferRequest.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/dto/ with fields: sourceAccount, destinationAccount, amount, transferType, description. Add Jakarta validation annotations (@NotNull, @Positive, @Size).
Create TransferResponse.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/dto/ with fields: transactionReference, status, message, timestamp.
Create FundTransferCompletedEvent.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/dto/ with fields: transactionId, sourceAccount, destinationAccount, amount, timestamp, status.

Create exception classes in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/exception/: InsufficientBalanceException, AccountNotFoundException, AccountInactiveException, DailyLimitExceededException, InvalidTransferAmountException, SelfTransferNotAllowedException.

Create TransferService.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/service/ with methods: initiateTransfer, validateTransfer, processTransfer, debitAmount, creditAmount, checkDailyLimit, createTransactionRecord, updateAccountBalances (using Feign client).
Create AuditService.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/service/ for audit logging.
Update existing TransactionService.java to integrate with new TransferService.

Create Feign client interfaces in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/feign/: AccountClient (for account validation and balance updates), AuthClient (for JWT token validation and user role checking).
Add validation logic for all business rules: account existence, active status, sufficient balance, daily limit (₹5,00,000), same account check, positive amount.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer validation logic correctly implements all business rules
Exception classes extend RuntimeException with proper constructors
Feign client interfaces have correct @FeignClient annotations
All DTOs use Lombok annotations and validation constraints
verification: Run mvn clean compile to verify code compiles
Create and run unit tests for TransferService validation logic
